item.title: Wells Fargo warns customers about bank imposter scams: 5 steps to protect yourself
item.description: Wells Fargo is warning customers about scammers posing as bank employees. Here are five steps to help protect your money and personal information.

item.title: Rob McElhenney’s Wrexham AFC to play Premier League’s Sunderland in preseason match at Subaru Park
item.description: Wrexham AFC, co-owned by Philly native Rob McElhenney, will return to the U.S. for a 2026 preseason tour that includes a match against Sunderland in the Philadelphia area.

item.description: For the first time since Delaware State Police Corporal Matthew "Ty" Snook was shot and killed in the line of duty, his widow Lauren is sharing how she is moving forward and honoring his legacy.Remembering Corporal Snook’s life and sacrificeCorporal Snook, a 10-year veteran, was killed while working an overtime shift at the Wilmington DMV just two days before Christmas. item.title: At least 5 hurt after building explosion in Logan Township: officials
item.description: A shelter in place was issued in Logan Township, Gloucester County, after officials say a building explosion occurred Wednesday. At around 2:36 p.m., Gloucester County officials say an explosion occurred at the Savita Naturals building located on the 600 block of Heron Drive. item.title: Fetterman defies Democrats, opposes Iran war powers resolution after US strikes
item.description: The Senate voted 47-53 against a war powers resolution requiring congressional approval for further attacks in Iran on Wednesday, with Pa. Sen. John Fetterman the only Democrat to vote against it.

item.description: Community members packed Quakertown Borough Hall on Wednesday, voicing support for five high school students arrested during a protest against ICE and calling for the police chief to step down.Community rallies behind students arrested at protestThe five students, known locally as the "Quakertown Five," were arrested on Feb. 20 after a protest at Quakertown Community High School escalated into a confrontation with police.
